Contracts

TopicKey point
Home improvement down payment$1,000 or 10% of the price, whichever is less
Right to cancel3 business days; 5 for owners 65 or older
Service and repair contractsSimplified rules at $750 or less
Change ordersIn writing, with the price effect, signed by both parties
Paying subcontractorsWithin 7 days of receiving a progress payment (B&P §7108.5)
Retention (private works)Capped at 5% for contracts from 2026 (Civil Code §8811); owner pays within 45 days of completion; prime pays subs within 10 days of receipt
Progress payments (private)Owner pays within 30 days of a written demand
Enforcing a lienNotice of completion recorded within 15 days of completion; sue within 90 days of recording the lien
